title: Make native process test probes zombie-aware for #187 and preserve the #132 reproduction limit
description: Make native process test probes zombie-aware for #187 and preserve the #132 reproduction limit
no_spec_change_rationale: Test-only correction of process liveness probes under existing DRIVE-19 and native timeout requirements; no product behavior or requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A new regression first fails when the shared probe uses only kill -0 on a killed, unreaped child. After the fix, the bounded common::alive probe reports that zombie as not alive, still reports a live sleep 60 child as alive, and is used by tests/timing.rs, tests/native.rs and tests/change.rs. Focused regressions and stressed repetitions pass on macOS and Linux, and fledge run linux-verify passes. src/checkpoint.rs and its lock test stay unchanged: #132 remains open with the handoff's 0/40 Linux rounds and 0/30 loaded rounds, with no speculative diagnostics or fix. No product behavior, HI wording or requirement text changes.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-19 requires a cause rather than a retry. Handoff evidence for #187 identifies a killed, not-yet-reaped zombie, not a surviving process; the rejected approach is changing product stop_tree behavior or weakening assertions. For #132, no reproduction means no speculative lock change. Preserve each PR's own session, run archive-first CI, and keep this to one test-reliability theme.
